name: Alleva Echo
description: Alleva Echo is a HIPAA-compliant ambient AI scribe built into the Alleva behavioral health operations platform—not available as a standalone product. Listens during sessions and generates structured, audit-ready notes in real time supporting DAP, SOAP, utilization review, and more. Key differentiator: recordings are never saved—only the compliant note remains. Part of the Alleva platform that integrates EHR, CRM, billing, and admissions across the substance use disorder (SUD) treatment continuum. Works alongside TravisAI, Alleva's integrated AI assistant. Custom enterprise pricing starting ~$800/month for the full platform. Best for residential treatment centers, addiction treatment facilities, and behavioral health organizations wanting an all-in-one operations platform with built-in AI documentation.

faqs.q: How much does Alleva Echo cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Alleva Echo is part of the Alleva behavioral health platform—not sold separately. Custom enterprise pricing starts around $800/month for the full platform including EHR, CRM, billing, and AI tools. Request a demo for personalized pricing.

faqs.q: Can I use Alleva Echo without the full Alleva platform?
faqs.a: No. Echo is built into the Alleva platform and requires an Alleva subscription. For standalone AI scribes, consider Freed ($39-119/mo), Mentalyc ($20-70/mo for therapy), or Upheal ($69/mo).
Yes. Alleva Echo is HIPAA compliant with BAA available. Key privacy feature: recordings are never saved—only the compliant clinical note remains, ensuring audit-ready documentation.

faqs.q: What note types does Alleva Echo support?
faqs.a: Alleva Echo generates DAP notes, SOAP notes, utilization review documentation, treatment plans, and discharge summaries—designed for behavioral health and addiction treatment workflows.

faqs.q: Alleva Echo vs standalone AI scribes: which is better?
faqs.a: Alleva Echo is best for residential treatment centers and addiction facilities wanting an all-in-one operations platform. For outpatient therapy, Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) is purpose-built for therapists. For general practices, Freed ($39-119/mo) offers flexibility with any EHR.
